title: My best friend chose peace
lesson: You don't need someone to complete you. If someone can't add to your peace, leaving kindly is also love, for yourself and for the child watching.

beats.vo: My best friend Nora ended a relationship on a Tuesday, over a cup of tea. No shouting. No drama.
beats.shot: Bright soft white autumn daylight from the window. Nora's small kitchen in her terraced house in mid-autumn: white walls, a pale wood worktop, a white sink under a window onto a small back yard with a young maple tree in red-orange leaves, two small orange pumpkins on the windowsill, a small round pale-wood table by the window with a bowl of red apples. Close-up on the pale-wood table: Nora's hands (slender olive-skinned hands, short clean unpolished nails, no rings) in a dark bottle-green fine-knit jumper sleeves tilt a brown teapot and pour hot tea into a plain white mug that stands beside a second white mug; the tea is already pouring, steam rises. The soft splash of tea pouring into a mug.
